request.user_excerpt:
Speaker: Elon Musk
Topic: tesla-robotaxi
Label every claim after #1 (11 transitions).

#1
claimId: 9ea0a7398c8b
said: 2016-10-19 (Tesla Autopilot 2.0 press call (reported by TechCrunch))
deadline: 201

transitions.label: escalated
transitions.note: Target changed from one fully autonomous Los Angeles-to-New York demonstration drive to more than one million robotaxis operating on roads.

transitions.label: softened
transitions.note: Scope changed from more than one million robotaxis on the road to an initial paid driverless ride service in Austin.

transitions.label: softened
transitions.note: Claim narrowed from launching a paid Austin service in June 2025 to saying the deployment would have no in-car safety driver.

transitions.label: softened
transitions.note: Deployment was limited to geofenced parts of Austin considered safest.

transitions.label: goalposts_moved
transitions.note: Focus changed from geofencing the Austin deployment to whether anyone would be sitting in the car.

transitions.label: softened
transitions.note: The deployment added a routing limitation, avoiding intersections unless Tesla was highly confident the cars would handle them well.

transitions.label: escalated
transitions.note: Scale changed from a constrained Austin deployment to hundreds of thousands, possibly more than one million, Teslas self-driving across the United States.

transitions.label: softened
transitions.note: Scale changed from hundreds of thousands or more self-driving Teslas to starting the robotaxi deployment with about 10 cars.

transitions.label: softened
transitions.note: Claim shifted from a specific initial fleet size and ramp-up to a general statement that Austin was looking good for launch in June 2025.

transitions.label: goalposts_moved
transitions.note: Target changed from an Austin robotaxi launch to one Tesla driving itself from the factory to a customer house.

transitions.label: escalated
transitions.note: Scale changed from one factory-to-customer autonomous drive to autonomous ride-hailing available to about half of the US population.
